test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - GK/CA (Held on: 03 Dec, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: gk
question: Select the correct statement.

options.text: In the Southern peninsular region, the temperature difference is quite low between summers and winters.
The climate of Gangetic plains is very stable throughout the year.
In the Thar desert, the temperature difference is quite low between summers and winters.
The climate of the Northern Himalaya region is very hot and humid.

solution:
The correct answer is __**In the Southern peninsular region, the temperature difference is quite low between summers and winters.**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Southern peninsular region of India experiences a maritime climate due to its proximity to the sea.
 
• This maritime influence leads to a relatively stable temperature throughout the year with minimal variation between summer and winter.
 
• The average temperature in this region ranges between 25°C to 30°C.
 
• Regions like Kerala, Tamil Nadu, and coastal Andhra Pradesh have moderate climate conditions due to the influence of the Indian Ocean.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Climate of Gangetic Plains**

 
 
• The Gangetic plains experience a continental climate with extreme temperature variations.
 
• Summers can be extremely hot with temperatures rising above 40°C, while winters can be quite cold with temperatures dropping below 5°C.
 
 
 
• **Climate of Thar Desert**
 
 
• The Thar desert experiences an arid climate with significant temperature differences between day and night and between seasons.
 
• Summer temperatures can reach up to 50°C, while winter temperatures can drop to near freezing point.
 
 
 
• **Climate of Northern Himalaya Region**
 
 
• The Northern Himalayas have a diverse climate ranging from subtropical in the foothills to alpine in the higher altitudes.
 
• The region experiences cold winters with heavy snowfall and mild summers.
 
• It is not characterized by hot and humid conditions.
